title: Risk-Controllable Multi-View Diffusion for Driving Scenario Generation

output_modality.value: multi-view driving video (nuScenes, 448 x 840 per camera, 16 frames)

control_signal.value: target risk level, scalar or time-resolved profile, turned into agent trajectories and 3D boxes; also HD map and text context

control_mechanism.value: two stages: risk embedded by MLP and applied by FiLM to BEV features of a GenAD-style motion generator; resulting trajectories and boxes injected as structured motion conditions into the diffusion backbone

base_model.value: MagicDrive-STDiT3 diffusion backbone (about 2.5B, initialized from MagicDriveV2) with VGGT geometry adapter, alignment module and region-aware DPO

datasets.value: nuScenes, 700 scenes for training and 150 for evaluation

metrics.value: FID, FVD, 3D detector mAP, MV-SSIM, Depth AbsRel, Fg-FID, DINO-FID

controllability_evidence.value: Paper says measured risk closely matches target but omits the analysis; qualitative quantiles 0.95, 0.8, 0.2. Fidelity: FID 15.70 versus 20.91, mAP 30.50 versus 18.17.

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop generation from observed multi-view history, 16-frame clips, no driving policy in the loop.

stated_limitations.value: Risk model covers only several typical interactions; results depend on quality of generated trajectories and 3D boxes.

notes: Risk control happens in the motion-generation stage; the video generator is conditioned on its output. No quantitative risk-matching numbers in packet.
